scope: The 80 candidates initially forced into synopsis review by an identity remap or model repair_needed flag.
policy: This ledger adjudicates source and catalog warnings only. It never approves a synopsis.

status_definitions.resolved: The minutes or an already-maintained canonical source resolve the warning.
status_definitions.source_repair_required: The minutes contain material omitted from the case page; repair the extract and regenerate the synopsis.
status_definitions.candidate_rejected: The candidate is attached to the wrong source or states the wrong operative result; do not ingest it.
status_definitions.canonical_repair_required: The answer is established by the minutes, but maintained canonical metadata still needs correction.
